_readme: Every AI Beacon can use. Choose the active one in Beacon > Agent > 'AI provider', then press Test.
NEVER put a key in this file. Write ${NAME} here and put NAME=the-key in D:\Youtube\Beacon\.env.
${A|B} = use A, or B if A is empty.  ${A:-text} = use A, or the plain text if A is empty.
kind: openai = any OpenAI-compatible service | anthropic = Claude with an API key | bedrock = AWS | claude_code = Claude subscription via the claude CLI.
Built in, no entry needed: foundry, foundry-vision, bedrock, claude-code (they read the older .env names).
To add a provider: copy an entry below, give it a new name, fill in base_url / model / api_key.
'use' pins a slot without the Agent tab: agent = the chat, autopilot = background passes (empty = same as agent), vision = images.
autopilot: 'auto' keeps Beacon's Autopilot running while that provider is selected (prepaid credits); 'manual' (the default) leaves the Off/On switch to you.

muse-spark.label: Muse Spark (Meta)
muse-spark.notes: Meta's Muse Spark through the Meta Model API — drop-in OpenAI-compatible with native parallel tool calling, so Beacon's tools work unchanged. Get a key from dev.meta.ai and put it in Beacon/.env as BEACON_META_API_KEY. Model ids: muse-spark-1.3 / 1.2 / 1.1.

foundry-thinking.label: Foundry · thinking
foundry-thinking.notes: The same Azure model as Foundry, asked to reason step by step before answering (reasoning_effort=high). Measured 2026-09-17 on DeepSeek V4 Flash: 4/4 on harder reasoning checks vs 3/4 normal, about twice as slow.

azure-openai.label: Azure OpenAI / Foundry (new account)
azure-openai.notes: A new Azure account. Endpoint = the resource URL from the Azure portal, model = your deployment name.

aws-bedrock.label: AWS Bedrock (another account)
aws-bedrock.notes: Uses an AWS CLI profile (run `aws configure --profile beacon`). Model = the Bedrock model or inference-profile id enabled in that account.

gemini.label: Google Gemini (AI Studio key)
gemini.notes: Key from aistudio.google.com. Model = a Gemini model name from AI Studio.

vertex-ai.label: Google Cloud Vertex AI
vertex-ai.notes: Google Cloud project with Vertex AI on. Needs the gcloud CLI signed in (gcloud auth login). Model looks like google/<model-name>. For location 'global' change the host to aiplatform.googleapis.com.

claude-api.label: Claude API (Anthropic key)
claude-api.notes: Key from console.anthropic.com (pay per use, separate from a Claude subscription).

openrouter.label: OpenRouter (many models, one key)
openrouter.notes: One key reaches Claude, GLM, Gemini, Qwen and more. Model = the id shown on openrouter.ai, e.g. z-ai/<model>.

local-ollama.label: Local model (Ollama)
local-ollama.notes: Runs on this computer, no account. Install Ollama, pull a tool-calling model, set its name here.
